# Arnav Khandelwal

> Software engineer and Electrical Engineering undergraduate at MNIT Jaipur. Builds Python and Java backends and AI-enabled systems, with public sources and explicit evidence limits.

## Profile
- [About](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/about): Education, backend internship, skills and résumé-attested recognition.
- [Contact](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/contact): Email arnavkhandelwal446@gmail.com; GitHub https://github.com/Arrnnnaav. Availability and response times are not promised.
- [Résumé](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/resume): Original owner-supplied résumé; résumé-only performance metrics are not independently verified.

## Selected work
- [Project Edge Node](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/work/edge-node): A local telemetry classifier with validated inputs, structured output and a documented localhost latency fix. The committed report records mean latency decreasing from 5.356s to 0.973s, with 50 latency requests and zero failures. Time to first token was measured separately over 10 requests.
- [Cited Multi-Agent Researcher](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/work/cited-researcher): A research pipeline that scales search effort to the question and keeps citations attached to its synthesis. The public README documents up to five concurrent search agents and a 33-unit-test suite. A separate résumé timing claim is excluded until a public benchmark is committed.
- [LedgerBridge](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/work/ledgerbridge): An auditable bank, ledger and Razorpay reconciliation engine with deterministic matching and a read-only narration layer. The README reports 103,049 records processed in 5.114s median engine time over five runs. Its sealed-benchmark consistency scores are explicitly not real-world accuracy.
- [GhostCursor](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/work/ghostcursor): A bounded local Windows assistant that highlights a trusted control, waits for a human action and verifies the resulting state. The public README reports 27/30 raw intent accuracy on its frozen test set and 361 hermetic tests. These describe the documented supported-workflow evaluation.
- [NeuroUX](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/work/neuroux): An experimental media-analysis pipeline that maps predicted cortical activation to transparent UX scoring formulas. The README reports video inference changing from 50 minutes to approximately 80 seconds after moving the encoder to GPU. This is a reported engineering observation, not a controlled benchmark.
- [StudyOS](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/work/studyos): A learning workflow connecting prerequisite-aware next topics, contextual questions and spaced review. The public repository documents Today → Point & Ask → Save to Review and an AWS deployment pipeline. No learning-outcome or adoption metric is claimed.

## Evidence policy
The public [design system](https://arnav-khandelwal.vercel.app/styleguide) documents the portfolio’s typography, accessible controls and source-linked evidence components.

Published measurements are repository-reported, with sample sizes and limitations shown in the case studies. NeuroUX scores are experimental proxies; LedgerBridge consistency is not real-world accuracy. Test counts describe repository documentation, not fresh executions. Cited Researcher’s résumé-only timing is excluded from visible metrics. No demo uptime, hiring availability or unverified LinkedIn identity is claimed.
